entities.summary: The National Metallurgical Academy of Ukraine, formerly known as the Dnipropetrovsk Metallurgical Institute (DMetI), is a state-sponsored university in Dnipro dedicated to the study of metallurgy. From 2021 part of Ukrainian State University of Science and Technologies as an institute of studies and research.
